# WYEA

> WYEA (Whittle and Ye Engineering Associates, Newport Beach, California) builds firm-owned document engines for specialty insurers, MGAs and law firms. Each engine reads the documents a firm already keeps, drafts from its own precedents, remembers what its team has decided, and states nothing it cannot locate in a source document.

- One isolated system per client. Client documents never train a model.
- Engagements start with a fixed-price one-week prototype on the client's own documents, then a fixed-price build and one monthly fee that covers hosting, support and model costs.
- Led by two principal engineers, Anderson Whittle and Johnson Ye.
- Not held today: SOC 2, ISO certification, third-party penetration test, client-hosted deployment, customer-managed keys, automated export and deletion.
